requirement: Soft delete a criterion: refuse the delete while a live risk factor, metric rule, or treatment protocol still references it, otherwise stamp IsDeleted/DeletedAt; report an unknown or already-deleted id as not found.

preconditions.text: A live criterion exists for the target id
Nothing live references the target criterion
A live risk factor, metric rule, or treatment protocol references the target
Only soft-deleted rows reference the target
The target id matches no live criterion, or it is already soft-deleted

inputs.text: Delete a criterion referenced only by a major/minor rule
Delete a criterion referenced by a risk factor, a rule, and a protocol
Delete a criterion that nothing references
Delete a criterion referenced by a risk factor
Delete request with an unknown id
Second delete request for an already deleted criterion
Delete a criterion referenced by a treatment protocol
Delete a criterion referenced by a scoring rule
Delete a criterion referenced only by soft-deleted rows

returns.text: Success with Deleted status; the criterion is soft-deleted and hidden by the query filter
Unrelated criteria and soft-deleted references stay untouched
Failure with BusinessRuleViolation for a live risk factor, metric rule, or treatment protocol reference
Failure with BadRequest when the criterion is missing or already deleted
Nothing is soft-deleted when the request is rejected

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
